purpose: Freeze one answer-model identity, decoding policy, official prompt family, evidence ordering, image placement, and answer-leak guard shared by all 14 Mem-Gallery methods.

upstream_authority.normalization: UTF-8 text after the official loader's strip().

user_content_order: selected evidence in frozen rank/prompt order
official speaker-aware question prompt plus category constraint
optional question-image marker and question image
request_contract.text_memory: Join whole caption-folded records in their selected order after the memory header.
request_contract.multimodal_memory: For each record emit raw dialogue text, then its source image id and image-content marker, then at most one frozen image reference.
request_contract.image_transport_boundary: The pure builder emits image_ref identities only. A later hashed endpoint client must resolve and base64-encode bytes beneath the accepted dataset root while retaining byte hashes.
request_contract.answer_leak_guard: Reject answer, gold, reference_answer, or original_answer fields before request construction.

accounting_requirements_for_future_clien: request identity and canonical request SHA-256 before image byte expansion
prompt, completion, and total tokens reported by the endpoint
wall time, HTTP status, response id, finish reason, and failed-call exception
all image source identities, byte sizes, and SHA-256 values
one final_answer call category distinct from memory-write, recall, router, and anchor calls

covered_invariants: model, temperature, output-token, and seed binding

next_gate: Implement a standard-library endpoint client and byte-safe image resolver, then run only mocked response/timeout/malformed-response tests. Real endpoint lifecycle remains blocked until Wave 1, dataset integrity, model inventory, and a fresh lifecycle prefreeze are all accepted.
authorization: This request-assembly contract authorizes no model service, real endpoint call, real image read, prediction, scoring, result admission, superiority claim, SOTA claim, or cleanup.
explicitly_prohibited: method-specific answer prompts or decoding changes in the matched table
passing raw answers into the builder or downstream client
silently omitting an evidence or question image after request construction
using a malformed or empty model response as an accepted prediction
treating request-shape tests as a reproduced baseline result
